glosses: transport (vehicle used to transport troops and equipment)

examples.text: O sistema de transporte naquela cidade é bom.
examples.en: The transportation system in that city is quite good.

examples.text: Você já viajou por transporte aéreo?
examples.en: Have you ever traveled by air?

examples.text: Tom construiu sua casa usando contêineres de transporte.
examples.en: Tom built his house out of shipping containers.
